name: ainobi-courseware
description: Author and edit AINOBI slide-based courseware via MCP tools and the ainobi CLI workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Create and edit AINOBI e-learning courseware scenes
interface.longDescription: Opens AINOBI courseware into a server-side workspace, runs validated ainobi CLI commands, and persists scenes with TTS/search host capabilities. Pair with the AINOBI MCP app for cloud courseware authoring in ChatGPT Desktop Codex / Work.
